specs.英文简介:
Kodak Gimini is a camera for 110 film, made around 1988, produced in Mexico, and available in a range of colors.[http://kodak.3106.net/index.php?p=211&cam=1026 Kodak Gimini] at [http://kodak.3106.net Kodak Classics]

Other very similar cameras included the Kodak Winner, Kodak Trimlite Instamatic 18, Kodak Mickey-Matic (first model), Kodak Kids Camera, My First Camera, Kodak Hawkeye Pocket Instamat
